article.excerpt: Which three economies in Europe have the lowest employment to population ratio, circa 2013? Greece, Croatia, and Serbia comes in last. That is from the World Bank and ultimately Eurostat, see p.5 (pdf). You will note of course that Croatia and Serbia have their own floating rate currencies. In Serbia the measured unemployment rate is about nineteen percent
